notes: Godot 4.7 sports game (v1.0.0) with sixteen events, a main menu, Learn to Play, and local multiplayer. Art and bitmap fonts are generated in-tree. SFX are generated (Versilian Community Sample Library CC0 plus synthesised). Music files are intentionally not in the public repo; the game plays to a steady beat without them. App icon is original (md5 d9a4bbb9a65765f94dc5c4b0cbdaaf77). No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp.
